description: Test fixture for tests/unit/test_assist_slope_crawl_diag.cpp (assists plan Part A). asphalt and grass are copied from data/surfaces/surfaces.json; grass_rg copies racing_game's game-owned grass entry (racing_game data/surfaces/surfaces.json at 2026-10-12: lambda_mu 0.63, crr 0.08 - an owner handling adjustment there, RACE-002, not a measurement) so the crawl diagnosis can run on the surface the owner drove on.

fields.lambda_mu: Pacejka-style friction scale relative to dry asphalt = 1.0.

grass.source: COPIED from data/surfaces/surfaces.json as it was at assists Part A (0.42; the shipped value is 0.6 since assists I2) - kept so Part A and the I2a before/after diag run on the surface the limit cycle was found on.

grass_rg.source: COPIED from racing_game data/surfaces/surfaces.json grass (owner adjustment 0.42 -> 0.84 -> 0.63, RACE-002); not a measurement.
